summary: Iteration 6 backend tested end-to-end: SendGrid-graceful invite (mocked when keys blank), marketplace scoring (score/recommended/match_reason + sort + user_industries), referral fulfillment with 5% payout persistence + idempotency, marketplace/payouts list with source-or-target filter and total_pending, and /workspaces/stats with role-shaped headlines/metrics. 12/12 new tests pass and all 143 prior tests still pass — 155/155 (100%). SendGrid delivery is MOCKED in this env (SENDGRID_API_KEY blank) — invite endpoint correctly returns email_sent=false with email_reason mentioning 'SENDGRID_API_KEY'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1659 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Per-module router split was explicitly deferred this iteration; recommend prioritizing it next iteration to keep the file maintainable.

_send_magic_link_email() shadows the module-level Mongo `client` with the SendGrid client inside the function scope — currently safe (function-local), but rename to `sg_client` to avoid future foot-guns.
payout.target_company_id can be a synthetic marketplace id like 'mp_ridgeline_logistics' that does not exist in db.companies; downstream UIs joining on company_id should handle this gracefully.
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral users/sessions/referrals/payouts inserted via Mongo + cleaned up in finally blocks. No persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 6 endpoints (invite/SendGrid fallback, marketplace scoring, fulfill referral + payout, payouts list, workspaces/stats) all pass. SendGrid keys remain intentionally blank so invite stays MOCKED — email_reason currently surfaces 'SENDGRID_API_KEY or SENDER_EMAIL not configured'. When SENDGRID_API_KEY is set in a later env, expect email_sent=true and a non-empty status — those positive-path tests are not yet written.
